description: Contains all resources (images, fonts, stylesheets, etc.) used by BYTM.

externalAssetPattern.description: Pattern passed to `new RegExp()` that identifies an external asset that will be loaded via fetching from the CDN instead of a locally cached @resource.

preloadAssetPattern.description: Pattern passed to `new RegExp()` that identifies an asset that should be preloaded when the page loads.

resources.description: Mapping of resource file identifiers and paths.

^[a-zA-Z]([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)?-[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+.description: Resource with a key in the format `prefix-resource_name` and a value that is either a path string or metadata object.

oneOf.description: Path or URL to the resource. If it's a path that starts with /, it's relative to the project root, else it's relative to the assets folder. Query strings and hashes are allowed. You may make use of the placeholders $MODE, $BRANCH, $HOST, $BUILD_NUMBER, $BUILD_TIMESTAMP and $BUILD_UID anywhere in the string.

path.description: Path or URL to the resource. If it's a path that starts with /, it's relative to the project root, else it's relative to the assets folder. Query strings and hashes are allowed. You may make use of the placeholders $MODE, $BRANCH, $HOST, $BUILD_NUMBER, $BUILD_TIMESTAMP and $BUILD_UID anywhere in the string.

ref.description: Git Ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA) to use when fetching the resource from the CDN. Defaults to the build number from src/constants.ts if not set. You may make use of the placeholders $MODE, $BRANCH, $HOST, $BUILD_NUMBER, $BUILD_TIMESTAMP and $BUILD_UID anywhere in the string. For example, use "$BRANCH" to always get the latest version of the resource on the build branch, or provide a version tag like "v3.0.0" to target a specific commit by version.

integrity.description: Whether to calculate a Subresource Integrity hash for the resource (works with URLs too). True by default, which means if a resource changes on the remote, the userscript manager will refuse to load it. Set to false if the resource is expected to change frequently and/or out of sync with the userscript updates.
